headline: F1 | Tax evasion case: 100 million paid. Bottas: "Nobody wants Imola because of the tax case"
summary: Investigations by the Bologna Financial Police led to the payment of 100 million euros by Formula 1 teams in a tax evasion case.
why: Formula 1 is run by the Formula One Group, a commercial owner of the championship, and tax settlements affect the cost base of the teams and the sport's business.
